title: ConfirmAnswer
description: `{"confirm": {...}}` on stdout, and nothing else beside it.

detail.description: One muted line under the label.

value.description: Comes back as `continuation.choice`. Unique, at most 200 characters.

url.description: An http(s) link for the step.

ExtensionConfirm.description:
What Penguin shows before running the action again. Limits are checked
strictly, like the manifest's: a confirm that breaks one is an error.

choiceLabel.description: The question above the choices, e.g. "Which task?".

choices.description: When present (1–20), the person picks one before confirming.

confirmLabel.description: The confirm button's text, e.g. "Close task". At most 40 characters.

detail.description: One line of context under the title. At most 300 characters.

state.description: Opaque; comes back unchanged as `continuation.state`. At most 8 KB.

steps.description: What confirming will do, in order. At most 12.

title.description: What will happen, e.g. "Close FOR-123 with a comment". At most 200 characters.
